Package management.domain

Class Stats

  • java.lang.Object
    • management.domain.Stats
  • public class Stats
extends java.lang.Object
    This is a entity class contains information about statistics.

    This class contains menu informations including these attributes and corresponding get and set methods:
    orders and payments : they are Order and Payment list to be done statistics
    soup, noodles ,etc.: they are sales volume of different types of dishes pyMethods: how many times has each payment method been used lastWeekSale: last week sales (money) used to generate chart Chart

    Author:
    Xiaotian Wang
